base_model_definition.import_semantics: all OPENWEPP_C3_WOODY_V2 topology, transaction, equation-family, fixed-constant, unsupported-branch, algorithm, tolerance, and guard authority is normative and unchanged except where V3 explicitly supersedes occupancy state, mixed leaf/stem radiation preparation, local wind, hydraulic geometry, potential-pass coupling, leaf respiration, diagnostics, and fixtures

canonical_section_extraction: UTF-8 bytes beginning with the exact start heading line and newline, ending immediately before the exact end heading line

hydraulic_geometry.common_root_node: all accessible soil layers connect in parallel to root_node_potential_mm
hydraulic_geometry.unsupported: negative layer flux is typed hydraulic redistribution rejection

leaf_respiration.carbon_debit: the same class-resolved Rd subtracted once from Ag is integrated once with sun/shade leaf area, interval, molar mass C, and tile fraction
leaf_respiration.nonpositive: typed invalid configuration or state for positive leaf area; exact zero only for zero leaf area
leaf_respiration.rd25_conversion: none: immutable CTSM source already returns umol CO2 m-2 leaf s-1; only interval carbon debit converts umol to kg C
leaf_respiration.temperature_response: stable log-domain Arrhenius times peaked response with Ha=46390 J mol-1, Hd=150650 J mol-1, S=490 J mol-1 K-1

migration_policy.ambiguous: report every unresolved occupancy root_node_potential_mm with reason ambiguous_v2_layer_root_warm_starts
migration_policy.v2_to_v3_root_node: complete only when every V2 layer-root f64 has bitwise-identical IEEE-754 bytes

numerical_failure_payload.model_digest_fixture_rule: the independent fixture uses BOUND_BY_V3_DEFINITION_NOT_ORACLE to avoid a model-definition/fixture digest cycle; implementations inject and validate the actual V3 definition digest

potential_pass.accepted_stage_a: uncapped by hydrology owner but coupled to vulnerability-limited hydraulics
potential_pass.internal_maximum: beta_sun=beta_shade=1 only for Emax and gsmax; never state or request

numerics.energy: centered sqrt-epsilon FD damped Newton, pivoted LU at 64*epsilon*matrix_norm, 50 steps, 20 halvings
numerics.hydraulic_outer: centered generalized FD damped Newton with identical pivot/step/halving limits
numerics.normalization: exact V7 energy operand-sum and water maximum-flux scales

potential_pass.persisted_beta_hyd: Emax-weighted mean of accepted beta_sun/beta_shade when Emax sum is positive; exact 1 for exact zero maximum demand; diagnostic/warm-start only
potential_pass.resolve: six unknowns and six independent residuals; re-solve class ci, Medlyn, dry-leaf energy, shared wet/store-cap, dry-stem, and canopy-air heat/vapor nodes inside every coupled evaluation
potential_pass.water_authorization: absent from potential pass; fixed caps enter only the subsequent capped pass

radiation_preparation.absorption_partition: for each band and incident component, physical leaf/stem shares are proportional to area fraction times one-minus-rho-minus-tau
radiation_preparation.clumping: K_eff=clumping_index*K over actual conditional plant area P
radiation_preparation.effective_optics: rho and tau are leaf/stem plant-area-weighted independently for VIS and NIR
radiation_preparation.leaf_area: L_sun=(L/P)*(1-exp(-K_eff*P))/K_eff; L_shade=L-L_sun with exact removable and zero branches
radiation_preparation.transport_solver: exact admitted whole-column two-stream matrix exponential with analytic particular solution and exact resonance integral branch
